name: Oatly
note: Swedish oat-drink maker; Oatly Group AB (publ) listed on Nasdaq (OTLY). Largest shareholder Nativus Company Limited (44.6% as of 2026-03-11), wholly owned by CR Verlinvest Health Investment Ltd, a 50/50 joint venture of Verlinvest S.A. and Blossom Key (Hong Kong) Holdings Ltd, a wholly owned subsidiary of China Resources (Holdings) Company Limited; China's SASAC performs the investor duty for China Resources Company Limited (90.0222%) on behalf of the State Council (Oatly FY2025 Form 20-F). Along the chain the Chinese state reaches about 20% of Oatly (0.446 x 0.5 x 0.900222). Co-title sponsor of EF Education-Oatly since 2025. Tier proposal: concern (see pull request).
